title: The Seventies Alcove
request: Fill the seventies alcove: every book stamped 1970 through 1979, earliest stamp first. Some stamps were typed onto the card as text, and the alcove still wants them.
objective: Use an interval predicate whose upper end is excluded, over a column that may hold numbers written as text.
hints: The alcove ends with 1979, and a stamp typed as text never compares with a number the way you expect.
are.between keeps values from its first argument up to but not including its second; int turns one stamp into a number.
Rebuild the year column as numbers first, then choose interval ends so that both 1970 and 1979 survive, and sort upward.
inputCode:
import random
from datascience import Table, make_array
titles = ['A Field Guide to Patient Rain', 'The Mapmaker Who Waited', 'Notes Left Under Stones', 'Lanterns of the Slow Tide', 'Winter Comes to the Aviary', 'The Quiet Arithmetic of Bees', 'Letters to a Distant Shell', 'An Atlas of Borrowed Weather']
n = random.randint(3, 7)
picked = random.sample(titles, n)
years = [random.choice([1968, 1970, 1971, 1974, 1976, 1979, 1980, 1983, 1991]) for _ in range(n)]
if random.random() < 0.4:
    years = [str(year) for year in years]
shelf = Table().with_columns('title', make_array(*picked), 'year', make_array(*years))

rows: A Field Guide to Patient Rain

fixtures.name: typed_stamps
fixtures.predicate: all(isinstance(stamp, str) for stamp in shelf.column('year'))

fixtures.name: alcove_stays_empty
fixtures.predicate: not any(1970 <= int(stamp) < 1980 for stamp in shelf.column('year'))

reference:
stamps = make_array(*[int(stamp) for stamp in shelf.column('year')])
tidy = shelf.with_columns('year', stamps)
deliver(tidy.where('year', are.between(1970, 1980)).sort('year'))

naive.code:
stamps = make_array(*[int(stamp) for stamp in shelf.column('year')])
tidy = shelf.with_columns('year', stamps)
deliver(tidy.where('year', are.between(1970, 1979)).sort('year'))
